title: BIOENGINEERING LABORATORY TECHNIQUES
description: Emphasizes fundamental laboratory techniques in bioengineering used to assess and manipulate molecular, cellular, and tissue level models.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: BB 451 and ((BI 231Z and 232Z) or BI 233).
A minimum grade of C is required in BB 451, BI 231Z, BI 232Z and BI 233.
